Script 1 · “The bottleneck”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If your business needs you for every decision, you don’t own a business. You own a job.”

Body

“Most service-business owners I meet aren’t short on ideas. They’re short on clarity. They try to fix everything at once, so nothing really moves. The owners who grow find the one constraint that matters most and fix that first.”

CTA

“I’m showing you how to find yours in a free live masterclass. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, blue backdrop and grey suit, same setup as your profile photo.

Script 2 · “AI as your team”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Before you hire your next person, ask this question.”

Body

“Which part of this job could AI do? Content, follow-up, SOPs, reporting. Owners are adding hires for work an AI agent could take on, then wondering why margins are tight. Use AI to multiply your team, not replace your thinking.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through where to start in my free 60-minute class. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “Multiply your team” in royal blue.

Script 3 · “Information isn’t the problem”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“You don’t need another course.”

Body

“At a certain level, entrepreneurs rarely suffer from a lack of information. What they need is someone to sharpen their thinking: what to do first, what to stop, and what to hand off. That’s what this class is about.”
